name: Naruto Shippuden 3D - The New Era
description: The first installment of ``NARUTO'' for Nintendo 3DS is an exhilarating side-scrolling ninja action game in which Naruto freely runs around the five great ninja kingdoms, recreated with great immersion using stereoscopic viewing unique to the Nintendo 3DS!The story is an original story full of mysteries, in which the five shadows, the strongest village chiefs in the ninja world, stand in front of Naruto. And the effects of special techniques such as "Senpo/Rasenshuriken" that seem to jump out of the screen are impressive! Sasuke, Naruto's eternal rival, also appears, and the story accelerates even more! Set on Nintendo 3DS, Naruto's unprecedented adventure begins now!!
platform_name: ニンテンドー3DSカードソフト
